title: The two Turkish documents are rewritten in English
name: The two Turkish documents are rewritten
description:
`docs/PLAYBOOK.md` (185 lines) and `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md` (217 lines) are written in Turkish; every other file in `docs/`, including `REVIEW-2026-08-28.md`, is English. Rewrite both in English, keeping every heading, table, ADR reference, file path and line citation exactly where it is — these are dated records of what was judged on those days, so the job is translation and never revision.

Two things stay Turkish and the node should not touch them: the Turkish strings in `packages/core/src/id.ts` and `packages/core/src/id.test.ts` are fixtures for the transliteration table and are the whole point of that test (`Ayrıştırma` → `ayristirma`), and the author's name in `LICENSE`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` and the three `plugin.json` files is a name.

Acceptance is a command: a search for Turkish-specific letters and a short Turkish word list over tracked files returns only those two exclusions.

brief.approach: Keep the completed translation commit unchanged unless the corrected checks expose a real content defect. Rewrite only `docs/PLAYBOOK.md` and `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md` in English, preserving paths, filenames, section numbering, tables, ADR references, `file:line` citations, dated measurements, and the original document structure. Preserve the five **→ ADR** markers, render all three **[KARAR]** markers as **[DECISION]**, and use the terse verdict-first register of `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-28.md` with `Hüküm:` rendered as `Ruling:`. Do not touch Turkish transliteration fixtures, the author's name, `docs/M1-GATE.md`'s quoted `ı`, or the immutable Turkish-derived node slug cited by `docs/adr/0057-the-host-question-tool-asks-and-the-agent-relays-the-pick.md`. Complexity is 3 / 10: the change is long but constrained to faithful translation of two documents and is checked mechanically for scope and preserved references.

acceptance.proves: No Turkish prose remains outside the pre-existing immutable node ID cited by ADR 0057.
No Turkish-only letter remains outside deliberate names, fixtures, quoted-letter text, and the immutable node ID.

acceptance.run: grep -q '^### 1.2' docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md && grep -q '^### 2.1' docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md && grep -q '^\*\*3.6 ' docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md && grep -q '^### 4.1' docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md
acceptance.proves: All four externally cited section markers remain in their original structural form, including 3.6 as bold prose.
Only the two authorized documents changed relative to the development base.
Markdown formatting and secret checks remain clean.
